scope: Connect the fixed PostgreSQL locking, occurrence copy and namespace choice rules to the installed PHP body.

common: Check::input(array_is_list($targets) && $targets !== [], 'DROP INDEX needs an ordered nonempty target list.');
Check::input($mode === IndexDropMode::Ordinary || count($targets) === 1 && !$cascade, 'DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY needs one target and RESTRICT.');
Check::input($target instanceof IndexReference || $target instanceof MissingIndex && $ifExists, 'DROP INDEX needs ordinary bound indexes or guarded absence.');
Check::input(!isset($names[$identity]) || $names[$identity] === $owner, 'Repeated index targets must agree on identity and presence.');
Check::input(!isset($schemas[$schema]) || $schemas[$schema] === $exists, 'Targets must agree on whether their schema exists.');
Check::input(!StockIndexNames::contains($release, new Name($schema), new Name($target->index->value)), 'A known stock relation cannot be an absent index.');
Check::input(array_intersect_key($names, $tables) === [], 'An indexed table cannot also be an index selector in the same schema.');

return 'DROP INDEX ' . ($this->mode === IndexDropMode::Concurrently ? 'CONCURRENTLY ' : '') . ($this->ifExists ? 'IF EXISTS ' : '') . implode(', ', $names) . ($this->cascade ? ' CASCADE' : ' RESTRICT');
Check::input(!IndexSchemas::system($schema->value) && !IndexSchemas::sessionInternal($schema->value), 'An ordinary index must belong to an application schema or pg_temp.');
Check::input($index->value !== $table->value, 'An index and its indexed table must have distinct relation names.');
Check::input($schema === null || $schema->value !== 'pg_toast' && !IndexSchemas::sessionInternal($schema->value), 'An absence cannot describe internal session schemas.');
Check::input(!$missingSchema || $schema !== null && !IndexSchemas::stock($schema->value), 'A missing schema must name a namespace that can be absent.');

Check::input($statement->kind === ObjectKind::Index && $context->profile->parameters === ParameterStyle::Native && $context->relationNames === Comparison::Sensitive, 'DROP INDEX requires the native PostgreSQL index profile.');
Check::input($selector instanceof DottedName && count($selector->parts) <= 2, 'DROP INDEX names a local index and optional schema.');
Check::input($name !== null, 'DROP INDEX needs a valid index name.');

return new DropIndex($targets, $statement->ifExists, $statement->behavior === DropBehavior::Cascade, $statement->concurrently ? IndexDropMode::Concurrently : IndexDropMode::Ordinary, $context->profile->grammar);
return new IndexReference(new Identifier($match->schema->value), new Identifier($match->index->value), new Identifier($match->table->value));
Check::input(!$context->indexNamespace->hasUnknownNames($schema) && ($context->complete || IndexSchemas::system($schema->value)), 'DROP INDEX cannot infer absence in an open index namespace.');
Check::input($optional, 'DROP INDEX requires a declared index.');
return new MissingIndex(new Identifier($name->name->value), $schema === null ? null : new Identifier($schema->value), $schema !== null && !$binding->known($context, $schema));
